svg.title: Owl & Quill — Bookplate Seal
svg.desc: A burgundy seal with an owl gripping a quill, an interwoven acanthus and rosette border, foliate inner ground and two clear letter cartouches. Warm ivory engraving on a transparent exterior. Outlined California sun lettering: Litt. (litteratura) on the left; Phil. (philosophia) on the right.
